functions.note: Signed arithmetic shifts and an unsigned divide meet in one expression. asmlift’s signedness lever is whole-function, so it cannot spell the per-site signedness this body needs — whichever way it is thrown, one of the two sites is wrong.

A `volatile u16` VALUE local held across three calls. `volatile` on a scalar local is the only C spelling that forces agbcc to give such a value a stack home instead of a callee-saved register, and asmlift has no such qualifier: its shipped `/volatile` lever qualifies a pointer’s pointee, never a value local. Chosen after the rule that a row must also be one m2c matches was dropped — m2c’s outcome was not a selection criterion for this row.
